# Push harder, speed up faster

<!-- STEP id="hypothesis" -->
Push a ball gently, and it starts to move slowly. Push it hard, and it starts to move fast. This gives a hypothesis: for the same object, a larger force gives a larger acceleration.

<!-- STEP id="cart" -->
To test it, make a cart from a cardboard box on wheels. Tie a thread to it. Pass the thread over a pipe at the edge of the table, and hang a paper cup with coins from it. As the cup falls, the thread pulls the cart with a constant force.
